senses.gloss:
अप्लव अ-प्लव, अस्, आ, अम्, without a ship;
not swimming.
—अ-प्लवेश (˚व-ईश), अस्, आ, अम्,
unable to swim.

आ-प्लव, अस्, m. bathing, sprinkling with water.
—आप्लव-व्रतिन्, ई, m. an initiated householder,
[]
who has passed through the first order (Brahma-cārin),
and is admitted into the second. See स्नातक.

आ-प्लाव, अस्, m. bathing, sprinkling, wetting; a
submerging; a flood, an inundation.

आप्लु आ-प्लु, cl. 1. A. -प्लवते, -प्लोतुम्, to
bathe, wash, immerse one's self; to jump up, dance:
Caus. P. -प्लावयति, -यितुम्, to cause to be bathed
or washed; to wash or wet; to overflow, overwhelm;
to set in commotion; A. -प्लावयते, to bathe.

आ-प्लवन, अम्, n. immersing, bathing, sprinkling
with water.
आ-प्लावित, अस्, आ, अम्, inundated, overflowed.
आ-प्लाव्य, ind. having wetted or sprinkled.

आ-प्लुत, अस्, आ, अम्, bathed; wetted, sprinkled.
In comp. sometimes used figuratively (e. g. स्नेहा-
प्लुत, overflowing with affection); (अस्), m. an ini-
tiated householder, see आप्लव-व्रतिन्; (अम्), n.
bathing.
—आप्लुत-व्रतिन्, ई, m. an initiated house-
holder; see आप्लव-व्रतिन्.
—आप्लुताङ्ग (˚त-अङ्˚),
अस्, ई, अम्, bathed all over.

आ-प्लुत्य, ind. having bathed, having washed;
having jumped up.
